001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.general;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.QSCancellable;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
007import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
009
010/**
011 * Fire when watcher processing the shop ongoing fee
012 */
013public class ShopOngoingFeeEvent extends AbstractQSEvent implements QSCancellable {
014
015  private final QUser player;
016
017  private final Shop shop;
018
019  private double cost;
020  private boolean cancelled;
021  private @Nullable Component cancelReason;
022
023  public ShopOngoingFeeEvent(final Shop shop, final QUser player, final double cost) {
024
025    this.shop = shop;
026    this.player = player;
027    this.cost = cost;
028  }
029
030  @Override
031  public @Nullable Component getCancelReason() {
032
033    return this.cancelReason;
034  }
035
036  @Override
037  public void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final Component reason) {
038
039    this.cancelled = cancel;
040    this.cancelReason = reason;
041  }
042
043  /**
044   * Getting the cost in this event
045   *
046   * @return The ongoing fee
047   */
048  public double getCost() {
049
050    return cost;
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Sets the ongoing fee to replace old one
055   *
056   * @param cost The ongoing fee
057   */
058  public void setCost(final double cost) {
059
060    this.cost = cost;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Getting related player in this event
065   *
066   * @return The player triggered ongoing fee event
067   */
068  public QUser getPlayer() {
069
070    return player;
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Getting related shop in this event
075   *
076   * @return The shop triggered ongoing fee event
077   */
078  public Shop getShop() {
079
080    return shop;
081  }
082
083  @Override
084  public boolean isCancelled() {
085
086    return cancelled;
087  }
088}
